name: typeahead-suggestions
notes: The typeahead popup is chunk[4] of the render_app layout — a separately budgeted row group that vanishes silently when suggestions go empty, taking the input's vertical position with it. ENV: the ORDER of the rows comes from ~/.operant/slash-usage.json (recency then frequency), so the text baseline is machine-specific; assert_screen deliberately checks only the recency-independent '[cmd]' marker. OBSERVED while authoring: two-or-more-character prefixes ('/sk', '/he', '/ex') currently paint zero rows while single-character prefixes ('/', '/s', '/h', '/st') do — a real inconsistency worth a follow-up, but not this scenario's job.
